action_items.text: A will do the minutes (meeting notes)
C will look at the actual appearance in the next break
Manuel (B) will work on the components (energy source, chip, infrared lamp, etc.)
Ryan (C) will work on how well the concepts will work with the user

decisions.text: Remote will be for TV only (not universal for all electronics)
Speech recognition will not be included (not worth the investment at this point)
Focus on modern, simple, easy-to-find remote design (one-handed use)
Include locator/tracking function (e.g., beep to find remote)
Colour scheme: yellow (bright) with grey/black buttons; slogan on bottom
Design should be user-centred, minimal buttons, hide rarely-used functions
